title: 14 October 2017: Ringo Starr live at Planet Hollywood Resort, Las Vegas
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on 14 October 2017.

It was the second show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s US tour, which lasted for 21 dates in October and November 2017, and the second of eight non-consecutive nights at the Planet Hollywood Resort.

I want to thank everybody 4 A great great Saturday night peace and love. ?????????? pic.twitter.com/Aa0xbSkHc5

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 15, 2017

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
